title: Compute brief - 13 October 2026
description: Bitdeer AI locks an 8-year, 60 MW A103 AI Cloud facility at Cyberjaya, Malaysia, lifting secured capacity to about 333.5 MW. Silicon tape is a quiet confirm day: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Enerflex books 1 GW-plus behind-the-meter gas for an unnamed North American data center; Fermi signs AMD credit support on Matador phase one.
og_kicker: Bitdeer A103 60 MW Malaysia; quiet tape
lede: Bitdeer AI converted another Malaysia shell into an executed deal: an 8-year data center services agreement for A103, a 60 MW (critical IT load) AI Cloud facility on its existing Cyberjaya campus alongside A101 and A102, designed for liquid-cooled NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks with energization aimed at Q1 2028. Campus AI Cloud capacity is expected to reach about 71.5 MW; Bitdeer's secured capacity rises to about 333.5 MW (about 95% of its up-to-350 MW target). No A103 offtake is disclosed yet. On the public silicon tape every venue returned HTTP 200 and every print confirmed yesterday's levels: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Separately, Enerflex said it won over 1 GW of behind-the-meter natural-gas generation for a large North American data center (backlog now over 1.75 GW through 2028), and Fermi signed AMD credit support tied to its 222 MW Project Matador phase-one lease in Texas.
